checks.check: Share of coins that come from ads for a regular player who watches every one

checks.check: The eleven a regular player builds on pack cards alone (no coin on players), against his division's par: the highest division average from the National League up, three seeds
checks.bar: Within 5 of par (the spread of the league itself)
checks.note: By division, the mean over par on cards alone: COUNTY LEAGUE 2.3, NATIONAL LEAGUE 2.3, LEAGUE ONE -1.5, CHAMPIONSHIP 3.0, ELITE LEAGUE 3.7. Before, on cards alone, he was 7 to 20 over (season by season: 13, 20, 16, 11, 13 from the County League to the Championship). The County League is the last one where a card is still drawn against the club's own eleven (up to 52).

checks.check: Share of ALL the coins a regular player earns in 180 days that goes on players (transfers and training)
checks.note: 303,280 of 824,679 coins. It is 50% of what is his to spend once the ground is whole, by assumption; the check says the game now has that much to sell him.

checks.check: What the coins buy: the regular player's eleven over par against the same player's on cards alone, County League to League One, three seeds
checks.note: Mean over par, cards only / half his spare coins / every spare coin: COUNTY LEAGUE 2.3 / 5.3 / 5.3; NATIONAL LEAGUE 2.3 / 5.0 / 6.0; LEAGUE ONE -1.5 / 3.4 / 6.4; CHAMPIONSHIP 3.0 / 0.7 / 4.4; ELITE LEAGUE 3.7 / 3.9 / 4.2. In the Championship and the Elite League the gap is small: the last points before the cap are dear and a season ages every player a year.

checks.check: What a regular player still has to buy on day 180 (every look, and his eleven to the cap, less his wallet), in weeks of his income
checks.note: 499,653 coins: 617,040 of sessions to the cap and the looks, against 304,637 in the wallet and 27,947 a week coming in. On cards alone (nothing spent on players, everything banked): 3.6 weeks. Every spare coin on players: 21.7 weeks. Before, he could pay for everything on day 57 and banked 24,000 a week after it.

checks.check: The day a strong player who watches every ad has coins for every sink (the ground, the staff, every look, his eleven to the cap)
checks.note: He earns 105,798 coins a week, four times a regular player. Counting only the ground, the staff and the looks: day 35 (it was 25). A thin margin: the last two points of rating are what hold him.

checks.check: The day a regular player (six wins in ten at par) reaches the Elite League
checks.bar: Eight weeks of daily play or more (day 56)
checks.note: The bar was first set at day 90 to 150; no price can meet that, and it was the wrong bar: on the game's own league (top two of eight go up) a manager who wins six in ten at par is promoted in 88% of seasons 5 over, 80% of seasons at par, 65% of seasons 5 under, 47% of seasons 9 under, 29% of seasons 14 under, 20% of seasons 20 under. A climb of 90 days needs him 12 under par the whole way up, so cards and coins would both have to be worthless. Other seeds: day 56 and 49; on cards alone 50, 50, 48. It was day 45, so the climb is a third longer than it was, and it ends with 18 weeks of income still to spend at the top. Two months of daily play to the top division is a fair length for a browser game; making it longer is a matter of who goes up or how hard a division plays, not of prices.

assumptions: Scenario forecasts, not player telemetry, human playtests or revenue forecasts.
Six minutes per match: four playing minutes at the default two-minute halves, plus an assumed two minutes of menus, stoppages and scenes. Ad watch time excluded.
Results are seeded with stated win/draw rates. Statistics are assumed; classic matches only, so Blitz and Hard challenges may remain incomplete.
All reached free rewards are claimed, and players select each next Journey after completing one. No paid passes, purchases, referrals or gem spending in base cases.

Two live objectives per match are assumed (25 coins, 13 XP); no atmosphere boost. Two keeper saves per match; 20% of matches are assumed A-grade (+5% match coins), all others receive no grade bonus. All income uses actual rule functions.
Coin totals are cumulative gross earning, including the 500-coin welcome, NOT spendable balances after club purchases. Each goal is estimated independently.

Free packs are availability counts, not assumed claims. Earned ticket counts exclude the starting two. Both are tracked separately; cards can improve squads or be sold, not both. Resale table estimates their additional value at fixed squad ratings.

Career prizes, board objectives, academy sales, sponsorship, commercial income, renewals and development spending are separate from these shared-loop scenarios: the career sheets (15 October 2026) simulate them.
No-ads and paid-doubler regular cases use identical results/random seeds. Optional ads case assumes one gem ad, gift ad and match ad per active day, no five-per-day coin-ad grind.
Ranges show 20 deterministic seeds at the stated assumptions; they are sensitivity ranges, not statistical confidence intervals.

Coming back (14 October 2026): the welcome week and the play streak are claimed on every day played; the MATCH OF THE DAY is completed on 40% (Learning), 60% (Casual), 75% (Regular) or 90% (Keen) of them. Looks handed over are counted at their shop price as looks, never as coins.

Club income: the modelled club puts 40% of every coin earned into its ground (cheapest part first, one build at a time, a league matchday on every day played) and its commercial manager; the ticket office is collected once on a day played (Keen: twice). No stadium style is bought, so the atmosphere is the ground's own.

The career (15 October 2026): ROAD TO GLORY on the game's own engine for 180 days, every match a career match, at 45/25/30 (3 days a week, 2 matches), 60/20/20 (daily, 3) and 75/15/10 (daily, 6, every ad). Who wins is assumed (the mix at par, moved by the rating gap and the division's difficulty) and so is what the manager buys; both are written out on the sheet Career By Season. Club Run, online play and SIM THIS MATCH are not in it.

Portal profiles (CrazyGames, Poki): nothing is sold. Casual takes one FREE GEMS offer a visit; Keen takes every FREE GEMS offer, the doubled gift, one match bonus and two FREE COINS a day. Days to afford run a 365 day horizon and assume nothing else is bought with that currency.
